## Parental OpControl 0.17.10

- Blocked replies now appear only once, inside the Luna chat. The duplicate safety notice above the input is gone; a notice area remains for real errors and clears on the next send.
- Luna dashboard times now use the family's time zone instead of UTC: Needs review, the review page, profile "Updated by", setup "tested" and the other dashboard pages.
- The Messages today tile now says "55 left today" instead of a bare number.
- When a child has no date of birth, the Luna page now explains how to add it and links to a new **Children** page where a parent can set it. No date of birth is added automatically.
- This release is offered to all devices through the normal catalog.
